1.focus: Sautuka na farko da kalmomi masu sauƙi na haruffa 3

2.focus: Sauran haruffan baƙaƙe, tare da ck, ff, ll, ss

3.focus: Haruffa biyu, sauti ɗaya — sh, ch, th, ng…

4.focus: Haɗaɗɗun wasula kamar ay, ee, igh, oo da ar

5.focus: Rabuwar haruffa biyu (a-e, i-e) da sababbin rubutu

6.focus: Wasu hanyoyin rubutu — wr, kn, ph, dge…

7.focus: Haruffa uku (ire, ore, ear) da ƙarshen -tion
